results.question: How many orders were placed last week?
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders
WHERE order_date >= date_trunc('week', DATE '2026-11-12')::date - 7
  AND order_date < date_trunc('week', DATE '2026-11-12')::date

results.question: Which 3 products had the biggest drop in revenue last week compared to the week before? Show the product name and the drop amount.
results.sql:
SELECT 
    p.name AS product_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-10-26' AND '2026-11-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END) -
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-11-02' AND '2026-11-08' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END) AS drop_amount
FROM products p
JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-10-26' AND '2026-11-08'
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name
ORDER BY drop_amount DESC
LIMIT 3
